content:
maria: Quick heads-up — seeing a perf regression correlated with KV/prefix cache hit drop on /chat-stream after the kernel-selector rollout. Hit rate 92% -> 61% (10m avg), token p50 up ~18%, p95 up ~12ms. Can we triage?

maria: PromQL I used:
```
sum by (route) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total[10m])) / sum by (route) (rate(kv_cache_requests_total[10m]))
```

maria: Snapshot (last 10m): /chat-stream hit=61% evict=2.4/s mem=3.2Gi reuse_ratio=0.29 kernel_variant=fast-gemm->fallback

ajay: @maria I saw this — the kernel selector change started rolling at 17:12 yesterday and finished canary -> prod at 02:07. I rolled a local rollback in canary but prod kept the new selector.

ajay: Profile excerpt (kv miss path):
```
kv_lookup() +6.3ms
kernel_dispatch(fast-gemm) -> fallback_xform +5.9ms
kv_evict_cleanup +2.1ms
```

derek: Agree we need per-route panels. Suggested minimal set: route hit%, evictions/s, mem bytes by route, reuse_ratio heatmap, token p50/p95, kernel_variant distribution.

derek: PromQLs:
```
rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])
sum by (route) (kv_cache_memory_bytes)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])))
```

perf-bot: ALERT kv_cache_eviction_rate high on prod-cluster (5m avg = 4.1/s) :warning:

maria: Assigning @ajay and @derek to dashboard work. Please also add an annotation for "kernel-selector rollout" at 17:12 yesterday.

ajay: Will add Grafana draft panels + JSON to infra-dashboards repo. ETA EOD today. Need list of top routes to seed.

derek: Top routes to include: /chat-stream, /embed-bulk, /rerank, /moderation, /completion-batch. Also add aggregate and by-customer view if possible.

maria: If we confirm heavy prefix thrashing we can either increase shard count or pin heavy prefixes to dedicated shards. Let's avoid immediate global rollback unless metric rollback confirms.

ajay: Noted. I'll correlate kernel_variant label with per-token latency and KV hitrate. Will post draft link once pushed. :thumbsup:

derek: Thanks — I'll add reuse_by_route heatmap and a token-level breakdown panel. Keep the alert channel intact.

maria: Great, keep updates short here. :eyes:
